themes.label: Ad Overload/Intrusiveness
themes.describe: Users complain about the frequency, type (video/full-screen), and general annoyance of advertisements.

themes.label: Stability & Bugs
themes.describe: Frequent reports of the app crashing, freezing, or failing to load properly.

themes.label: Login & Sync Issues
themes.describe: Users report being randomly logged out or unable to log back into their accounts.

themes.label: Lack of TV Show Support
themes.describe: A recurring request to expand tracking and rating capabilities to include television series.

themes.label: Feature Gaps/Enhancements
themes.describe: Requests for specific functionality like collaborative lists, better search, or adding unlisted titles.

themes.label: Poor User Experience (UX)
themes.describe: Complaints regarding confusing navigation, clunky interfaces, or poor design elements.

themes.label: Privacy & Data Tracking
themes.describe: Concerns raised about data tracking, third-party sharing, and privacy policies.

themes.label: Praise
themes.describe: Reviews that are purely positive about the app's core functionality or concept.
